# GitHub Actions

Workflows from upstream Stirling PDF were removed for this personal **PDF-Control** fork.

They were flooding notifications (nightly E2E, enterprise E2E, scheduled dependency updates, etc.) and need Stirling org secrets that this repo does not have.

GitHub Actions is also disabled at the repository settings level.

To re-enable CI later: turn Actions back on under **Settings → Actions → General**, then add only the workflows you need.
